blockerDetails.summary: Cross-plan write-lock conflict: src/main.ts is content-pinned by plan_fps audit tests outside the plan_final 03-002 write lock.
resolutionOptions: Retire plan_fps as superseded prior art (mirror plan_engine treatment) under explicit governance approval.
Update plan_fps SHA / substring assertions to track a new thin-wrapper src/main.ts content (expands write lock beyond declared 03-002 scope).
Defer 03-002 to a future governance step that resolves the cross-plan write-lock conflict on src/main.ts.
blockerDetails.downstreamImpact: 03-002 is not a prerequisite for any other FINAL_PLAN_STEPS entry. The final acceptance gate at 13-011 will correctly report 03-002 as not-COMPLETED until governance resolves the blocker.

selectorBehavior.rationale: plan_final/select-step.ts now skips BLOCKED status JSONs at selection time. BLOCKED steps do NOT satisfy prerequisites, so downstream steps that list 03-002 as a prereq would remain blocked (none currently do).
